text:
The text contains two distinct parts. The first sentence, "Name the amphibian that can change its color to blend with the environment," is a neutral, factual query. However, the second part, "Looks like we're gonna hit bad weather this weekend. Better pack up some umbrellas if you're planning to go out. Just giving you a heads up!", uses contractions ("gonna"), imperative phrasing without polite markers, and idiomatic expressions ("heads up"). This combination of casual vocabulary and structure indicates an informal tone.

informal
